d: Bihar is making its voice heard in Indian Hip-Hop! From Bhojpuri rap to the growing Desi Hip-Hop movement, artists from the state are bringing their language, culture and stories to the mic. At The Lallantop's Bihar Adda 2026, Abhishek Manchanda teams up with Hustle 5 finalist Raaj Babu and viral-sensation Arinar Black to talk about their music, their journeys and the rise of Bhojpuri rap. How is Bihar finding its place in the Indian as well as Global Hip-Hop scene? What makes regional-language rap so powerful? And can Bhojpuri rap take Desi Hip Hop or DHH to a whole new audience?
